SELECT s.section_id AS sectionId, s.section_name AS sectionName, s.direction AS direction, AVG(sd.duration_seconds) AS avgDurationSeconds, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM section_driving sd INNER JOIN section s ON sd.section_id = s.section_id
AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) >= 7 AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) < 9
AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) >= 17 AND HOUR(sd.start_date_time) < 19
GROUP BY s.section_id, s.section_name, s.direction ORDER BY avgDurationSeconds DESC LIMIT #{topN}

SELECT s2.route_number AS routeNumber, s2.section_id AS sectionId, s2.path AS path FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT route_number FROM section WHERE start_station_id = #{stationId} OR end_station_id = #{stationId} ) rn JOIN section s2 ON s2.route_number = rn.route_number WHERE s2.path IS NOT NULL AND s2.path != '' ORDER BY s2.route_number, s2.section_id

WITH first_route_station AS ( SELECT rs.station_id FROM route_station rs WHERE rs.route_id = #{routeId} AND rs.station_id > 10000 ORDER BY rs.id LIMIT 1 ), endpoints AS ( SELECT sec.route_number, sec.start_station_id AS station_id, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(sec.section_id, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED) * 2 AS sort_order FROM section sec WHERE sec.route_number LIKE CONCAT(#{routeId}, '_%') UNION ALL SELECT sec.route_number, sec.end_station_id AS station_id, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(sec.section_id, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED) * 2 + 1 AS sort_order FROM section sec WHERE sec.route_number LIKE CONCAT(#{routeId}, '_%') ), first_section_station AS ( SELECT e.route_number, e.station_id FROM endpoints e JOIN ( SELECT route_number, MIN(sort_order) AS sort_order FROM endpoints WHERE station_id > 10000 GROUP BY route_number ) first_ep ON first_ep.route_number = e.route_number AND first_ep.sort_order = e.sort_order ), selected_route AS ( SELECT route_number FROM ( SELECT fss.route_number, 0 AS priority FROM first_section_station fss WHERE fss.station_id = (SELECT station_id FROM first_route_station) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT( #{routeId}, '_', CASE r.is_up_or_down WHEN '上行' THEN 'up' WHEN '下行' THEN 'down' ELSE r.is_up_or_down END ) AS route_number, 1 AS priority FROM route r WHERE r.route_id = #{routeId} ) candidates ORDER BY priority LIMIT 1 ) SELECT s.section_id AS sectionId, s.path AS path FROM section s WHERE s.route_number = (SELECT route_number FROM selected_route) ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.section_id, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED)

WITH first_route_station AS ( SELECT rs.station_id FROM route_station rs WHERE rs.route_id = #{routeId} AND rs.station_id > 10000 ORDER BY rs.id LIMIT 1 ), endpoints AS ( SELECT sec.route_number, sec.start_station_id AS station_id, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(sec.section_id, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED) * 2 AS sort_order FROM section sec WHERE sec.route_number LIKE CONCAT(#{routeId}, '_%') UNION ALL SELECT sec.route_number, sec.end_station_id AS station_id, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(sec.section_id, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED) * 2 + 1 AS sort_order FROM section sec WHERE sec.route_number LIKE CONCAT(#{routeId}, '_%') ), first_section_station AS ( SELECT e.route_number, e.station_id FROM endpoints e JOIN ( SELECT route_number, MIN(sort_order) AS sort_order FROM endpoints WHERE station_id > 10000 GROUP BY route_number ) first_ep ON first_ep.route_number = e.route_number AND first_ep.sort_order = e.sort_order ), selected_route AS ( SELECT route_number FROM ( SELECT fss.route_number, 0 AS priority FROM first_section_station fss WHERE fss.station_id = (SELECT station_id FROM first_route_station) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT( #{routeId}, '_', CASE r.is_up_or_down WHEN '上行' THEN 'up' WHEN '下行' THEN 'down' ELSE r.is_up_or_down END ) AS route_number, 1 AS priority FROM route r WHERE r.route_id = #{routeId} ) candidates ORDER BY priority LIMIT 1 ) SELECT s.section_id AS sectionId, CONCAT(COALESCE(ss.station_name, s.start_station_id), ' → ', COALESCE(es.station_name, s.end_station_id)) AS sectionName, s.path AS path, COALESCE(sds.avg_duration_seconds, 0) AS avgDuration FROM section s JOIN route r ON r.route_id = #{routeId} LEFT JOIN station ss ON ss.station_id = s.start_station_id LEFT JOIN station es ON es.station_id = s.end_station_id LEFT JOIN section_driving_summary sds ON sds.section_id = s.section_id WHERE s.route_number = (SELECT route_number FROM selected_route) ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.section_id, '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
SELECT section_id AS sectionId, path FROM section WHERE path IS NOT NULL AND path != ''
